messages:
Alex: Heads up, I'm trying to trace a request across proxy -> app -> model-serving but Kibana shows the proxy hop, then nothing for the same trace id after the gateway. Seen from eu-west. Time window ~ 2026-02-18 11:23UTC. Anyone else seeing gaps?

Priya: Which trace id? paste it and exact time and I'll run the Loki cross-search. Also which index pattern (proxy-*, app-*)?

Alex: trace id 0a1b2c3d-9f8e-7a6b-5c4d-3e2f1a0b9c8d. Kibana query I used: `kibana: index:proxy-* | message: \"0a1b2c3d\"` returns the envoy access logs, but `index:app-* message:\"0a1b2c3d\"` returns nothing.

Cheng: Can you paste the raw proxy log line? need to confirm header name forwarded. sometimes envoy gets upgraded and header key changes.

Alex: raw proxy line: `2026-02-18T11:23:12.123Z INFO envoy access id=0a1b2c3d method=POST path=/v1/infer upstream=10.4.2.11:8080 src=10.1.7.9`

Maria: Huh, that `id=...` looks like a proxy-assigned request id, not the upstream `x-trace-id`. Did we change the header mapping in the envoy filter last week? I remember a PR that renamed `x-request-id` -> `x-rw-request-id` to avoid clashes.

Priya: If the upstream app reads `x-request-id` but proxy rewrites to `x-rw-request-id`, the app logs will have a different id. We should search for both. Try this Loki query to scan both fields across the time window: 

```
{job=~"(proxy|app).*"} |= "0a1b2c3d" or |= "x-rw-request-id" or |= "x-request-id"
| json \n| line_format "${request_id} ${message}"
```

Cheng: Also check Tempo/Jaeger for span id: `trace=0a1b2c3d` — if there's a distributed trace then Tempo should show spans even if logs don't. Sometimes the trace header is `uber-trace-id` or `x-b3-traceid`.

Alex: I ran a Tempo query, nothing. App never emitted span. Prometheus grafana panel shows envoy_request_total for that pod increased but `app_requests_total` stayed flat at that second. Looks like proxy accepted the request but dropped or timed out before forwarding.

sre-bot: Alert fired: `proxy_forward_errors` on eu-west pool (firing at 11:23:15, 3 occurrences). Link: https://grafana.internal/alerts/8231

Maria: That alert aligns. Could be a connection pool exhaustion or new circuit-breaker defaults. Check envoy stats for upstream 503s/conn close: `envoy_cluster_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx` and `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_pending_overflow`.

Cheng: Quick Loki search for 503/overflow around timestamp:

```
{job="proxy"} |= "pending_overflow" or |= "503" | duration > 30s
```

Priya: Found a burst of `pending_overflow` on proxy-12 at 11:23:12-11:23:18. Stack shows `circuit_breakers: MAX_PENDING_REQUESTS` tripped after the recent config bump. PR #4125 reverted?

Alex: That matches the missing app logs. So request id exists in proxy but proxy never forwarded. Root cause likely the new envoy cb defaults.

Maria: Immediate mitigation: scale up envoy pool for eu-west (replicas +1) and temporarily lower the max_pending_requests setting to previous value. I'll run a controlled deploy to revert the config.

Priya: For long term, we should: 1) standardize header mapping (x-rw-request-id -> x-request-id) in proxy filter; 2) add ingestion pipeline in Kibana to index both `request_id` and `x-rw-request-id`; 3) add a Grafana panel for `trace-correlation-missing_rate` (ratio of proxy logs with id that have no matching app log within 5s).

Cheng: Also change alerting: current alert only fires on proxy errors. Add a synthetic SLO alert that watches the correlation rate (proxy_request_count with matching app_request_count) sliding 5m, alert if <99%. That will catch silent drops.

Alex: As a stopgap, I was able to join by src IP + path + timestamp window to find candidate app logs for some requests. Example Kibana search: `index:app-* AND src:10.1.7.9 AND path:\"/v1/infer\" AND @timestamp:[2026-02-18T11:23:10 TO 2026-02-18T11:23:16]` — found two entries that look like retries. Not ideal but helped debug payloads.

Maria: I'll patch envoy config in staging now and roll to eu-west canary. Expect a small bump in forwarding success. Will follow up when done.

ops-bot: Deploy started by Maria: revert-envoy-cb-config eu-west Canary -> success on proxy-12 at 11:29:30

Priya: Post-deploy, correlation rate back to baseline in Grafana. I've opened a ticket to add the ingestion parsing and correlation panel: INF-2319. Also creating a follow-up RFC to standardize request id header across layers.

Cheng: Notes for the runbook: when you see `proxy has id but app does not` check: 1) envoy pending_overflow, 2) header mapping, 3) tempo trace presence, 4) quick IP+ts join. Add the runbook to oncall playbooks.

Alex: Thanks all. If anything else pops up I'll re-open. :thumbsup:
